citations.claim: body accelerated with excessive force at violating step
controller work applied with force 83.44 exceeding fmax 64.18

counterfactual.change: set controller noise from 0.228 to 0.0; this removes stochastic perturbation added to commanded force, keeping force within fmax and eliminating violation

explanation: Controller with seeded sensor noise computes force as kp*velocity_error plus noise, but clamping to fmax is either missing or applied before noise addition. With noise=0.228, force 83.44 exceeds fmax 64.18 at step 1. Setting noise to 0 keeps force ~46.3 within limit, proving noise pushes command over limit.
vision_note: Tile 0 shows a single red body centered right of a green waypoint cross in an otherwise empty arena. In tile 1 the body remains in essentially the same position with no visible wall contact, penetration, or large motion.
